rows.commentary: 7.3: Simon Keene targets a full length and extracts substantial swing on off-stump, prompting Yashasvi Jaiswal to gently nudge the ball toward mid-wicket.
7.4: Simon Keene offers a driveable length outside the off-stump, but Yashasvi Jaiswal resists the temptation and leaves it alone.
7.5: Simon Keene delivers a shortish ball angling into off, which Yashasvi Jaiswal pulls across the line over mid-wicket before a chasing fielder cuts it off near the fence to allow three runs.
7.6: Simon Keene bowls a back of a length delivery shaping in toward middle and leg, causing Devdutt Padikkal to shuffle slightly and block it in the direction of mid-wicket.
8.1: Fraser Sheat tests Yashasvi Jaiswal with a sharp bouncer directed at leg-stump, forcing the batter to duck beneath it.
8.2: Fraser Sheat attacks from back of a length on leg-stump, and Yashasvi Jaiswal shifts inside the line to tuck it away in front of square on the leg-side where Clarke gathers.
8.3: Fraser Sheat probes the tight off-stump channel with menacing seam movement away, completely foxing Yashasvi Jaiswal as he prods forward defensively.
8.4: Fraser Sheat drops it back on a length angling into off stump, and Yashasvi Jaiswal gets behind the line to dead-bat it straight toward the covers.
8.5: Fraser Sheat attacks on a length outside off with subtle air movement, inviting Yashasvi Jaiswal to lean forward and tap the ball softly to the covers.
8.6: Fraser Sheat pitches fuller on the fourth stump line, and Yashasvi Jaiswal leans into the stroke, guiding it firmly toward extra cover.
9.1: Kristian Clarke delivers from a short of length angle down the leg-side, leaving Devdutt Padikkal to offer no shot.
9.2: Kristian Clarke persists on a length angling down leg once more, and Devdutt Padikkal wisely lets it pass through.
9.3: Kristian Clarke strays down the leg-side with a full swinger, leaving Devdutt Padikkal grasping at thin air as he tries to whip it away.
9.4: Kristian Clarke searches for his rhythm yet again with another full, leg-side delivery that evades Padikkal's attempted clip.
9.5: Kristian Clarke alters his length and angles it into off, but Padikkal stands tall behind a solid, defensive wall.
9.6: Kristian Clarke bangs it in hard and shapes it down leg, allowing Padikkal to nudge it toward fine leg for a single.
10.1: Zak Gibson digs this back of a length and targets the leg-stump line, drawing Devdutt Padikkal across his crease before rapping him high on the thigh pad for a dot.
10.2: Zak Gibson maintains a hard length down the leg-side, and Padikkal wisely pulls his bat away from the line.
20.4: Zak Gibson pitches it full and swings it in towards off, prompting Devdutt Padikkal to advance a couple of steps and ease the ball straight to mid-on.
20.5: Zak Gibson digs this one in short and well outside off, watching Devdutt Padikkal prudently let it sail through to the keeper.
20.6: Zak Gibson delivers a short of length ball angling in on off, and Devdutt Padikkal covers the line behind a solid defensive wall.
21.1: Simon Keene pitches it up outside off, inviting Dhruv Jurel to stroke it cleanly on the up towards mid-off.
21.2: Simon Keene extracts sharp seam movement away from a back of a length outside off, beating Dhruv Jurel's tentative poke as furious Kiwi appeals are turned down by the umpire.
21.3: Simon Keene targets a back of a length outside off, and Dhruv Jurel watches it pass safely through to the keeper.
21.4: Simon Keene attacks a good length outside off, leaving Dhruv Jurel to comfortably withdraw his bat and leave it alone.
21.5: Simon Keene operates from a back of a length just outside off, allowing Dhruv Jurel to hang back and tap the ball toward point.
21.6: Simon Keene pushes a slightly overpitched delivery onto off, pushed straight back to the bowler as Keene completes a maiden.
22.1: Fraser Sheat finds a sharp seam-away from a back of a length, opening up Devdutt Padikkal for a thick outside edge that races safely wide of third slip for four.
22.2: Fraser Sheat angles an inswinging length ball into Devdutt Padikkal, whose forward movement traps him on the pads for a hopeful lbw appeal turned down due to outside-off impact.
22.3: Fraser Sheat serves up a full delivery swinging into off stump, which Devdutt Padikkal meets with a composed defensive block.
22.4: Fraser Sheat drops it full onto the pads, allowing Devdutt Padikkal to glance it smoothly toward mid-wicket for a single.
22.5: Fraser Sheat digs it in short on off stump, prompting Dhruv Jurel to swivel and pull hard toward long leg where the chasing fielder restricts them to one.
22.6: Fraser Sheat spears in a lifting short-of-length delivery that darts away, leaving Devdutt Padikkal hanging back and beating the outside edge entirely.
23.1: Simon Keene strikes as Dhruv Jurel edges it away, safely snaffled by Rhys Mariu to deepen the visitors' struggles.
25.2: Simon Keene targets the channel outside off, getting the ball to seam in as Devdutt Padikkal expertly covers his stumps to let it pass safely.
25.3: Simon Keene pitches it full and swings it into off-stump, prompting Padikkal to lock bat and pad together for a secure defense.
25.4: Simon Keene serves up an inswinging length ball that Padikkal shuffles across to flick off the inner half into the mid-wicket pocket for a single.
25.5: Simon Keene delivers a fullish ball around off, which Yash Rathod leans forward to stroke cleanly in the direction of the covers.
25.6: Simon Keene bangs it in hard on a length outside off, leaving Rathod to hoist his bat skywards and watch it sail through to the keeper.
26.1: Fraser Sheat drops one short of a length on middle that shapes away, allowing Padikkal to hang back and tap it gently towards backward point.
26.2: Fraser Sheat digs in a sharp bouncer around off, forcing Padikkal to swiftly duck underneath its trajectory.
26.3: Fraser Sheat fires a full delivery swinging into off, and Padikkal on the move simply pushes it right back down the pitch to the bowler.
26.4: Fraser Sheat hits a steady length on off, and Padikkal covers the line expertly to dead-bat it back onto the pitch.
26.5: Fraser Sheat delivers back of a length with inward shape on off, met by a resolute stonewall defense from Padikkal covering the line.
26.6: Fraser Sheat pushes a fuller length around off, prompting Padikkal to prod forward and block it solidly into the off-side.
27.1: Simon Keene lands a good length delivery around off, and Rathod watches it all the way to leave it alone.
27.2: Simon Keene hits a back of a length outside off, seaming sharply inward as Yash Rathod bravely trusts the bounce and lets it sail just over the off-stump to draw gasps from the slips.
27.3: Simon Keene lands it full, hooping sharply back into off, and Yash Rathod can only bunt it off the inner half straight to mid-on.
27.4: Simon Keene delivers a fuller length around off, catching Yash Rathod early into the drive as the ball chips uppishly before dropping safely short of the cover fielder.
27.5: Simon Keene pitches it up around off, allowing Yash Rathod to ease it toward covers and comfortably rotate the strike.
27.6: Simon Keene bowls full outside off to Devdutt Padikkal, who leans into a push toward covers before deciding against the single as the players break for Lunch on Day 1.
36.4: Fraser Sheat drops short down the leg-side, and Yash Rathod dismissively pulls it to the fine leg fence for four.
36.5: Fraser Sheat attacks the stumps on a length, gently nudged by Yash Rathod toward mid-on for an easy single.
36.6: Fraser Sheat angles one sharply down the leg side, trapping Mukesh Choudhary on the pads as he attempts a gentle tuck.
37.1: Simon Keene drops it short, and Yash Rathod dances down the track, carving a ferocious boundary toward long-on under mounting pressure.
37.2: Simon Keene delivers a ticklish length on middle and leg, deftly nudged away through the on-side with feather-soft hands for a couple.
37.3: Simon Keene digs it in short, Yash Rathod skips down the track and flails wildly into the empty air.
37.4: Simon Keene angles one wide of off stump, drawing an ambitious drive that trickles off Yash Rathod's inside edge down to fine leg.
37.5: Simon Keene drops it short again, Yash Rathod swivels cleanly and guides the pull down to fine leg for a single.
37.6: Simon Keene fires a length delivery past the advancing Mukesh Choudhary, who opts to leave it cleanly for the waiting gloveman.
38.1: Fraser Sheat digs it in short, and Yash Rathod dismisses the bouncer over deep square leg to bring up the hundred for India A with a maximum.
38.2: Fraser Sheat strays onto the pads, allowing Yash Rathod to effortlessly flick it over fine leg for consecutive maximums in a crucial rescue act.
38.3: Fraser Sheat serves a back-of-a-length delivery around off, crisply driven toward cover before refusing the single.
38.4: Fraser Sheat extracts sharp inward movement from a good length, forcing Yash Rathod to defensively push it right back at the bowler.
38.5: Fraser Sheat unleashes another short ball, causing Yash Rathod to lose his shape entirely as a mistimed pull dribbles toward square leg.
38.6: Fraser Sheat drops short to Yash Rathod, who pounces and launches a majestic pull over deep backward square leg for maximum.
Yash Rathod is on fire, smashing two massive sixes off the last two balls to race to 44!
39.1: Simon Keene attacks a length on middle and leg, pushed firmly back down the surface by Mukesh Choudhary.
39.2: Simon Keene fires a short, wide delivery angling away outside off, completely eluding Mukesh Choudhary's flashing blade.
39.3: Simon Keene completes a magnificent five-wicket haul as Mukesh Choudhary edges to Tim Robinson, who takes a sharp low catch in the slips to wrap up the innings at 113.
8.2: Anshul Kamboj angles it in from a good length, clipping Heaphy softly toward mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
8.3: Anshul Kamboj targets the stumps with a skiddy length delivery that thuds into Rhys Mariu's pads, harmlessly drifting down the leg-side.
8.4: Anshul Kamboj extracts late inward movement off a fuller length, forcing a leading edge from Rhys Mariu through cover for a brisk brace.
8.5: Anshul Kamboj darts one into the hips of Rhys Mariu, who misses the stroke entirely as the ball deflects off his pads toward square leg for a leg bye.
8.6: Anshul Kamboj extracts sharp bounce and inward nip to smash into Heaphy's glove, bringing the physio rushing onto the turf to treat a swollen right hand.
9.1: Auqib Nabi oversteps for a no-ball before floating a full delivery that Rhys Mariu pushes into the off-side.
9.1: Auqib Nabi tests the back of a length as Rhys Mariu defends defensively, the ball narrowly avoiding a tragic deflection back onto his own stumps.
9.2: Auqib Nabi lands a short of a length delivery outside off, and Rhys Mariu wisely sways out of the line as it nips away.
9.3: Auqib Nabi operates outside off on a steady length, watching Rhys Mariu comfortably leave the ball alone as it moves away.
9.4: Auqib Nabi produces an absolute peach on a length around off, squaring up Rhys Mariu completely with vicious late seam movement past the edge.
9.5: Auqib Nabi persists on a length around off, beating Rhys Mariu once more as the batsman dances down the track past another snaking delivery.
9.6: Auqib Nabi drops short outside off, allowing Rhys Mariu to wait on the ball and carve a late boundary through backward point.
10.1: Akash Deep steams in and forces Curtis Heaphy to push firmly straight to mid-on.
10.2: Akash Deep digs one in sharply, catching Curtis Heaphy on the shoulder as he fails to duck away in time.
10.3: Akash Deep pitches it up outside off, inviting Curtis Heaphy forward to dead-bat the delivery.
10.4: Akash Deep extracts some late away movement, leaving Curtis Heaphy unbothered as it sails past outside off.
10.5: Akash Deep strays down the leg-side, prompting Jurel to launch into a brilliant diving grab to his left.
16.6: Mukesh Choudhary hits the deck on a back of a length outside off, probing away with movement that beats Heaphy's hesitant poke.
17.1: Auqib Nabi searches for swing with a full delivery curving into middle and leg, safely flicked toward mid-wicket.
17.2: Rhys Mariu hangs back on a short of a length delivery on the fifth stump channel, watching it sail through for a leave.
17.3: Rhys Mariu blocks a back of a length delivery off the inner half toward mid-on, scampering across for a quick single.
17.4: Auqib Nabi targets a length outside off with a hint of inswing, allowing Heaphy to cover his stumps and offer an assured leave.
17.5: Heaphy tucks a short of a length delivery seaming toward leg inside the line, racing back for a comfortable couple toward deep backward square leg.
17.6: Auqib Nabi's sharp jag-back beats Heaphy's outside edge and clips the pad, but optimistic appeals for caught behind and lbw are correctly waived away.
18.1: Rhys Mariu chases a full and wide delivery outside off from Mukesh Choudhary, flashing hard with a loose drive that finds only air.
18.2: Mukesh Choudhary pitches on a length across middle and leg, neatly tucked away by Rhys Mariu toward mid-wicket.
18.3: Rhys Mariu expertly ducks underneath a sharp bouncer directed cleanly on middle and leg by Mukesh Choudhary.
18.4: Rhys Mariu gets into the line of a shortish delivery on off with supreme timing, pulling it emphatically through mid-wicket to find the boundary rope.
18.5: Rhys Mariu marches down the track to meet a length ball on middle, solidly defending it out toward wide mid-off.
18.6: Mukesh Choudhary lands a peach in the corridor of uncertainty that seams away to beat Rhys Mariu all ends up from the crease.
19.1: Auqib Nabi bangs it in on a hard length outside off, leaving Heaphy to watch it sail through.
19.2: Auqib Nabi angles a length delivery toward leg-stump, allowing Heaphy to work it quickly toward short mid-wicket for a single.
19.3: Rhys Mariu pushes an inswinger from Auqib Nabi off the inner half through backward square leg, capitalising on Mukesh's wayward throw for three runs including an overthrow.
19.4: Auqib Nabi digs it back of a length on off to straighten and fly just short of Rahul at second slip off Heaphy's outside edge.
19.5: No-ball from Auqib Nabi to Heaphy.
19.5: Auqib Nabi delivers to Heaphy, who turns it securely toward mid-wicket for a single.
19.6: Auqib Nabi finishes the over as Rhys Mariu works the ball away to backward square leg for a single.
28.6: Akash Deep finds sharp inward seam from a good length, leaving Curtis Heaphy content to let it pass.
29.1: Anshul Kamboj floats it up outside off and extracts substantial away movement, ignored entirely by Rhys Mariu.
29.2: Kamboj digs it in shorter into the surface, beating Rhys Mariu on the defensive prod as the ball darts away.
29.3: Rhys Mariu uses soft hands to clip Kamboj away toward square leg and scampers through for a single.
29.4: Kamboj pushes it marginally fuller on off stump, squeezed securely toward mid-off by Curtis Heaphy.
29.5: Curtis Heaphy works Kamboj cleanly toward mid-on, racing across for a sharp single.
29.6: Rhys Mariu skewing a leading edge toward backward point prompts an immediate change of willow.
30.1: Akash Deep squares up Curtis Heaphy on the defensive crease, forcing an outside edge that skids toward gully.
30.2: Akash Deep fires this delivery well outside off, leaving Curtis Heaphy a comfortable spectator.
30.3: Playing with soft hands, Curtis Heaphy gets an outside edge off Akash Deep that dies well short of Padikkal at first slip.
30.4: Akash Deep extracts vicious late away movement to square up Rhys Mariu's defensive push.
30.5: Putting his muscular frame into the delivery, Akash Deep digs it short for Rhys Mariu to watch sail through to the keeper.
30.6: Akash Deep drops this on a good length outside off, and Rhys Mariu pokes and misses once more.
31.1: Washington Sundar fires it in, Heaphy shoulders arms as it deflects off the pads toward short fine leg.
31.2: Washington Sundar watches Heaphy turn this away into the mid-wicket pocket for a quick single.
31.3: Washington Sundar keeps it tight as Rhys Mariu gently pushes the ball toward mid-wicket.
31.4: Washington Sundar tosses it up to Rhys Mariu, who nonchalantly laps it down to the fine leg fence for four to bring up the team hundred and push himself into the sixties.
31.5: Washington Sundar pitches full, and Rhys Mariu drills the drive straight back at the bowler.
31.6: Washington Sundar induces a flick away toward square leg to rotate the strike.
38.6: Mukesh Choudhary breaks the opening partnership as Rhys Mariu falls lbw for 76 after getting squared up on the defense.
39.1: Auqib Nabi drifts a full delivery in towards off, allowing Curtis Heaphy to squeeze it away for a single.
39.2: Auqib Nabi lands it a fraction fuller outside off, prompting Jayden Lennox to push a dot ball toward cover.
39.3: Auqib Nabi attacks from round the wicket with a yorker-length delivery, safely dug out by Jayden Lennox.
39.4: Auqib Nabi fires it full and straight from round the wicket, forcing Jayden Lennox to fend it off toward the off-side.
39.5: Auqib Nabi cleans up the nightwatchman Jayden Lennox as a length ball tails in and uproots the off stump for a duck.
39.6: Auqib Nabi strikes twice in two balls, trapping Tim Robinson lbw low on the pads to leave the batsman stranded on zero.
40.1: Mukesh Choudhary bowls it pitched up from round the wicket, met with a straight squeeze down the pitch by Curtis Heaphy.
40.2: Mukesh Choudhary targets the channel and watches Curtis Heaphy wisely leave the ball through to the wicketkeeper.
40.3: Mukesh Choudhary tests the batsman, and Curtis Heaphy responds by turning a brisk single toward mid-off.
40.4: Mukesh Choudhary slides a short delivery down the leg-side, skimming the pads of Matthew Boyle for a leg bye.
40.5: Mukesh Choudhary finds good length outside off, completely beating Curtis Heaphy on his forward defensive prod.
40.6: Mukesh Choudhary finishes Day 1 with a wayward ball down the leg-side, safely gathered by the tumbling keeper to signal Stumps.
47.1: Anshul Kamboj begins the over with a full delivery on the off-stump, blocked cleanly to mid-off by Heaphy.
47.2: Heaphy steps down the pitch to meet length, guiding the ball securely towards cover.
47.3: Curtis Heaphy cops a thick inside edge to mid-on as a hint of inward movement tests the right-hander.
47.4: Curtis Heaphy watches a back of a length delivery pass safely outside off into the keeper's gloves.
47.5: Washington Sundar reacts sharply at silly mid-off to smother a fierce drive from Heaphy's front foot.
47.6: India wrap up back-to-back maidens as another good length ball outside off is left alone.
48.1: Matthew Boyle tucks his shoulder and shoulders arms as Akash Deep probes just outside off.
48.2: Matthew Boyle survives a major scare as a sharp inside edge eludes the diving keeper's fingertips on its way to the fine leg boundary for four.
48.3: Matthew Boyle gets forward to a good length delivery on off-stump, tapping it straight back to Akash Deep.
48.4: Matthew Boyle stands tall on the crease, dead-batting the ball into the off-side.
48.5: Matthew Boyle leans into a gorgeous half-volley outside off, piercing the gap with a pristine off-drive for four.
48.6: Akash Deep targets the good length channel once more, safely blocked away from the front foot by Boyle.
49.1: Anshul Kamboj targets that probing corridor outside off, prompting Curtis Heaphy to push the ball straight back to the bowler.
49.2: Anshul Kamboj delivers a sharp short ball that handcuffs Curtis Heaphy on the pull, forcing a miscued miscue straight into the waiting hands of Mukesh Choudhary.
49.3: Anshul Kamboj pitches on a good length around off, where Dean Foxcroft shuffles across to deaden the ball off an inside edge toward mid-wicket.
49.4: Anshul Kamboj tests the channel outside off, and Dean Foxcroft meets it firmly off the front foot.
49.5: Anshul Kamboj conjures a masterpiece on an awkward length, nibbling away past Dean Foxcroft's groping outside edge.
49.6: Anshul Kamboj lands one outside the off stump, allowing Dean Foxcroft a clear view as he shoulders arms to the keeper.
50.1: Akash Deep fires it back of a length outside off, leaving Matthew Boyle untroubled as he watches it through to the gloves.
58.6: Mukesh Choudhary attacks the stumps on a familiar corridor, safely dealt with off the back foot by Mitchell Hay.
59.1: Akash Deep induces a thick inside edge off Dean Foxcroft, scrambling a single past a sprinting mid-wicket fielder.
59.2: Akash Deep drops it on a good length outside off, met firmly on the front foot by Mitchell Hay.
59.3: Akash Deep is driven cleanly down the ground by Mitchell Hay, whose textbook full-face stroke races past a diving mid-on for four.
59.4: Akash Deep tests the channel outside off, stoutly blocked on the front foot by Mitchell Hay.
59.5: Akash Deep tests the back of a length outside off stump, easily watched past by Mitchell Hay.
59.6: Akash Deep probes on a good length outside off, anchored securely in the crease by Mitchell Hay's dead-bat defense.
60.1: Auqib Nabi searches for away movement on a good length outside off, ignored completely by Dean Foxcroft.
60.2: Auqib Nabi targets the fifth-stump channel, smoothly smothered under the eyes by a soft-handed Dean Foxcroft.
60.3: Auqib Nabi drifts onto the pads, neatly tucked away into the square leg region by Dean Foxcroft for a couple of runs.
60.4: Auqib Nabi errs down the leg side, punished by Dean Foxcroft who glances the length ball away to the unprotected fine leg boundary for four.
60.5: Auqib Nabi corrects his radar to a disciplined good length outside off, neatly patted toward cover-point by Dean Foxcroft.
60.6: Auqib Nabi targets a good length well outside off, prompting Dean Foxcroft to shuffle across and nudge it toward the bowler's left.
61.1: Akash Deep offers width with a fuller delivery outside off, and Mitchell Hay watches it sail past without a stroke.
61.2: Akash Deep angles it into the right-hander from a wide channel, finding Mitchell Hay solidly behind the line for a defensive push to mid-wicket.
61.3: Akash Deep pitches full on off stump, inviting Mitchell Hay to stride forward and drive firmly straight to mid-off.
61.4: Akash Deep digs it in short with sudden pace, forcing Mitchell Hay to sway away and let the ball pass safely.
61.5: Akash Deep drifts onto the pads, allowing Mitchell Hay to work it neatly away toward backward square leg for a couple of runs.
61.6: Akash Deep strikes with a sharp delivery that catches the edge of Mitchell Hay, and Dhruv Jurel completes a regulation dismissal behind the stumps to end the twenty-four-run knock.
63.6: Washington Sundar darts a brisk one into middle, forcing Simon Keene to nudge it straight to short mid-wicket as a maiden commences his spell.
64.1: Auqib Nabi finds the edge off Dean Foxcroft's bat, the ball dropping safely through the cordon and skipping down to the third man boundary.
64.2: Auqib Nabi watches Dean Foxcroft dab the ball toward mid-on and sprint across for a rapid single that beats the keeper's end throw.
64.3: Auqib Nabi hurls a testing length delivery outside off, and Simon Keene wisely offers no shot as it sails through.
64.4: Auqib Nabi targets the stumps, and Simon Keene steps forward to dead-bat the ball securely onto the on-side.
64.5: Auqib Nabi pitches back on middle and leg, allowing Simon Keene to comfortably tuck it away toward the leg side.
64.6: Auqib Nabi draws a thick outside edge from Simon Keene's back-foot stroke, sending the ball flashing past a desperate gully dive and all the way to the fence.
65.1: Washington Sundar drifts an off-break onto middle and off, which Dean Foxcroft quietly works around to the leg side.
65.2: Washington Sundar flights it up, and Dean Foxcroft meets it firmly with a forward defensive block.
65.3: Washington Sundar tosses it on middle, prompting Dean Foxcroft to wrist the ball past the leg-slip fielder.
65.4: Washington Sundar floats one wide of off, where Dean Foxcroft drives through the covers before a slight misfield allows a scampered second run.
65.5: Washington Sundar gets his delivery away, and Dean Foxcroft turns the ball neatly into the mid-wicket region.
65.6: Washington Sundar floats one up outside off and Dean Foxcroft drills it straight back to the bowler, bringing a close to the morning session as Lunch is called on Day 2.
66.1: Anshul Kamboj attacks a fuller channel outside off, and Simon Keene wisely lifts his bat to let it pass through.
66.2: Anshul Kamboj pulls back his length sharply outside off, catching Simon Keene slightly squared up on the back-foot defense.
66.3: Anshul Kamboj targets the stumps on a good length, and Simon Keene meets it firmly off the front foot with the sweet center of his blade.
66.4: No run for Simon Keene off Anshul Kamboj.
77.1: Yashasvi Jaiswal tests Kristian Clarke with a fraction short delivery outside off, punched cleanly off the back-foot straight to cover-point.
77.2: Yashasvi Jaiswal loops it up on middle and leg, drawing a soft edge from Kristian Clarke as he moves back, rolling it harmlessly into the off-side.
77.3: Yashasvi Jaiswal drifts one in on middle and leg, securely defended into the on-side by Kristian Clarke.
77.4: Yashasvi Jaiswal tosses it up on middle and leg, worked away toward long-on by Kristian Clarke to rotate the strike.
77.5: Yashasvi Jaiswal serves a flighted delivery on middle and leg, nudged behind square on the on-side by Fraser Sheat for a quick single.
77.6: Yashasvi Jaiswal slides a low full-toss onto off, hammered straight back down the pitch into the bowler's hands by Kristian Clarke.
78.1: Washington Sundar floats one up on middle and leg, met by a leaning defensive prod from Fraser Sheat into the on-side.
78.2: Washington Sundar targets middle and leg with a flighted delivery, stabbed firmly onto the on-side by a half-forward Fraser Sheat.
78.3: Washington Sundar slows it down and drifts it into the right-hander, expertly blocked into the on-side by Fraser Sheat.
78.4: Washington Sundar tosses it up on off, prompting Fraser Sheat onto the back foot to push it securely into the off-side.
78.5: Washington Sundar offers one just outside off, and Fraser Sheat dances down the track to absolutely hammer a ferocious drive straight past the helpless wide mid-off fielder to the boundary.
78.6: Washington Sundar loops it up just outside off, dropped softly wide of cover-point by Fraser Sheat to claim a sharp single.
79.1: Yashasvi Jaiswal comes round the wicket with flight, and Fraser Sheat steps back to punch it straight to cover.
79.2: Yashasvi Jaiswal drops it down the leg side, beating Fraser Sheat's attempted sweep as the ball deflects off the pads toward short fine.
79.3: Yashasvi Jaiswal floats one onto middle and leg, allowing Kristian Clarke to nudge it wide of mid-wicket for a quick single.
79.4: Yashasvi Jaiswal fires it through on off, and Fraser Sheat forces it straight back down the pitch to the bowler.
79.5: Yashasvi Jaiswal strays well down leg, giving Fraser Sheat the opportunity to sweep it behind square for a comfortable single.
79.6: Yashasvi Jaiswal loops it up on off stump, and Kristian Clarke eases the ball down to long-on to rotate the strike.
86.6: Auqib Nabi pitches it short of a length outside off, and Zak Gibson pushes it straight back down the pitch to the bowler.
87.1: Akash Deep digs one in back of a length, and Kristian Clarke gets a massive top-edge on the whip that sails completely lost into the background over long leg.
87.2: Akash Deep tests the good length on off, allowing Kristian Clarke to shuffle across and clip it neatly behind square on the on-side for a single.
87.3: Akash Deep hits a good length on off and holds its line, drawing Zak Gibson into a push that beats the outside edge entirely.
87.4: Akash Deep bangs it in short at the right-hander, and Zak Gibson simply ducks underneath the delivery to let it pass.
87.5: Akash Deep serves it short of a good length just outside off, prompting Zak Gibson to punch off the back-foot straight to cover-point.
87.6: Akash Deep delivers a fuller length outside off, and Zak Gibson inside-halves his drive towards mid-on.
88.1: Anshul Kamboj offers a fuller length outside off, and Kristian Clarke presses across to hoist it high over mid-on and over the ropes for a maximum.
88.2: Anshul Kamboj fires a fuller delivery well wide of off, tempting Kristian Clarke into a slash away from his body that beats the outside edge.
88.3: Anshul Kamboj attacks the stumps full, and Kristian Clarke prods across to clip it through mid-wicket for a single.
88.4: Anshul Kamboj bowls on a good length just outside off, forcing Zak Gibson's bottom hand off the handle as a thick inside edge skews past square leg.
88.5: Anshul Kamboj goes short at the right-hander, catching Kristian Clarke on the forearm as he shuffles across on the pull.
88.6: Anshul Kamboj digs it in short, and Kristian Clarke swiftly adjusts, swiveling on the pull to deposit it behind square on the on-side for four.
89.1: Akash Deep angles it in from round the wicket, forcing Zak Gibson to comfortably duck beneath the short delivery.
89.2: Akash Deep follows the backing-away Zak Gibson with a sharp short ball, inducing an inside edge off the pull down to deep backward square leg for a single.
